config_name.description: Internal configuration type used by VESC Tool. This is not a user setting.

hw_name.description: Identifies the JFBMS Slave firmware hardware target. This is not a user setting.

slave_id.description:
Address of this JFBMS Slave on the battery-monitor CAN bus, from 1 to 8. Give each slave a unique ID and use consecutive IDs from 1 through the Number of Slaves configured on the Master or JF Link.

This is not a VESC controller CAN ID. A duplicate or missing ID prevents reliable pack data.

A new ID applies when written without restarting the device; update the parent configuration to match.

can_baud_rate.description:
CAN bus speed used to communicate with the Master or JF Link. Every device on this physical bus must use the same speed.

For a standard JFBMS Master dedicated slave bus, select 500 kbit/s. With JF Link, match its configured CAN Baud Rate.

Write the configuration and reconnect at the new speed.

cells_ic1.description:
Number of series-connected cells measured by the first/lower BQ monitor, from 3 to 16. This must match the physically wired cells, not the number of cells in parallel.

Total series cell count is Cells IC1 + Cells IC2. Follow the board wiring diagram for unused cell inputs.

Writing a change automatically reinitializes the monitors and stops balancing during reinitialization.

cells_ic2.description:
Number of series-connected cells measured by the second/upper BQ monitor. Set 0 if it is unused; otherwise use 3 to 16 to match the wiring.

Values 1 and 2 are invalid. Total series cell count is Cells IC1 + Cells IC2.

Follow the board wiring diagram for unused inputs. Writing a change automatically reinitializes the monitors and stops balancing during reinitialization.

temp_bq1_en.description:
Enables the external NTC sensor connected to the lower BQ monitor temperature input. Enable only if that sensor is physically fitted, then set NTC Resistance and Beta to match it.

An enabled sensor with an invalid reading is reported as a temperature fault and blocks parent control that requires valid temperatures. Disabled means this sensor cannot protect cell temperature; internal BQ temperature is still monitored.

Changes apply automatically after writing.

temp_bq2_en.description:
Enables the external NTC sensor connected to the upper BQ monitor temperature input. Used only when Cells on Upper BQ is greater than 0.

Enable only for a fitted sensor and configure NTC Resistance and Beta. An enabled sensor with an invalid reading is reported as a temperature fault and blocks parent control that requires valid temperatures.

Disabled means this sensor cannot protect cell temperature; internal BQ temperature is still monitored. Changes apply automatically after writing.

temp_res.description:
Nominal resistance of each external NTC temperature sensor at 25 degrees C, in ohms. Select the value from the sensor datasheet; for example, select 10k for a 10000-ohm NTC.

This setting applies to all enabled external NTC sensors. An incorrect value gives incorrect temperatures and therefore incorrect temperature limits.

Sensor settings apply automatically after writing.

temp_beta.description:
Beta coefficient of the external NTC sensors, in kelvin (K), from the sensor datasheet; for example, 3435. It must match the fitted sensors and be greater than 0 when any external sensor is enabled.

This setting works together with NTC Resistance to convert resistance into temperature. Sensor settings apply automatically after writing.
